I currently live in the Dominican Republic, where I have spent the past year teaching English to the local learners. This experience has made English teaching a huge passion of mine; therefore, it's my goal to assist as many people as possible on their English-learning journey! A few extra facts about me: I love cooking new foods, reading books, watching horror movies, anime, and listening to podcasts.

pro_course_detail.title: B1-C2 Boost Your Conversational English! Materials and Resources Included!
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to improve your conversational skills? I'm here for you!  

These lessons will be laid-back yet structured and focused. I will use lesson plans that include exercises for all aspects of English learning: reading, writing, listening, and speaking. I will also take written notes in Google Docs, documenting your speech and making corrections.

All material and notes used throughout our sessions will be then saved into a dedicated Google Drive and shared with you so you can access them anytime you want.

pro_course_detail.title: B1-C2 Simple English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to improve your conversational English in a relaxed setting? You've come to the right place! 

These sessions will focus on enhancing your conversational skills. We will use conversation topics or free talk to help build your confidence with speaking. Throughout our sessions, I will provide you with verbal corrections to any mistakes you may make. I’ll also suggest new phrases and vocabulary to help you sound more like a native speaker.

We can talk about various topics: how your day is going, your favorite foods, your hobbies/interests/etc. Or we can go through an article or youtube video together and have a discussion about it. Or I can find a bunch of conversation starter questions and we can talk about that. I have a number of resources for topics and conversation starters, so we will never run out of things to talk about!

Before I went to Japan, I spent about 5 months teaching English on italki. I've returned to teach on here once again. English is a difficult language! I can help you pronounce words correctly, speak more naturally, and help you decipher difficult slang and phrases. Please let me know what you would like to do.
teacher_info.cancel_policy: I would prefer at least a 36-hour notice for a lesson cancellation because that allows some time for another student to possibly reserve a lesson for the canceled time slot. I understand that technical issues may arise and things in life come up, but you need to communicate this to me as soon as possible. If you are a new student and it's your first lesson with me, I'm VERY strict about this because you need to prove that you are reliable and will show up on time.

NEW STUDENTS: If you are booking a lesson with me for the first time, please send a brief message along with your request. I ask for this so I know prospective students have read my profile description and watched my introduction video. For example:

- Hello, Aura. I'd like to practice my English conversation skills. I'm looking forward to speaking with you soon.
- Hello, Aura. I don't have many opportunities to practice English conversation, so I'd like to book a session with you to practice.
- Nice to meet you, Aura. I would like to improve my English speaking skills, and I would appreciate it if you could correct my mistakes and teach me how to speak more naturally.

As long as you have a basic understanding of English, you are welcome to practice English conversation with me. We can talk about everyday topics, or maybe you have an interesting life story to share.

I'm open to different topics, but I always enjoying talking about food, cooking, nutrition, health, holistic living, yoga, creativity, language learning, Japan, travel, world cultures, music, and technology, for example.

Some examples of other activities I've done with students:
- Scene description using pictures, photographs, or film clips
- The student describes a word and I try to guess the word, or vice versa
- I teach an idiom or other expression, and the student tries to guess the meaning
- Practicing tongue twisters

As a native speaker of American English, I can help you find the words and expressions to express yourself naturally.

- Hello, Aura. Can we practice reading an article together and then discuss it afterwards? Can you correct my pronunciation when I read the article?
- Nice to meet you, Aura. I would like to practice giving my work presentation with you. If I book a session, could you give me some feedback?

Reading Practice:
We can practice reading online articles, or maybe you have your own material you'd like to practice reading with me.  I can correct your pronunciation, word stress, and tell you how to properly link certain words together. For example, the phrase, "What are you going to do today?" sounds more like: "Whaddar ya gonna do taday?" when spoken out loud. We can do shadowing practice. I can read some text and then you can repeat after me, trying to match my rhythm, intonation, pronunciation, and word stress. Or, you can read it by yourself without shadowing me.

Proofreading:
I can check pieces of writing such as e-mails or short essays for errors and clarity. I proofread documents during the lesson time, with the student.

Presentation Practice:
Maybe you need to give a PowerPoint presentation or speech at an event or assembly. You can practice it with me while I give necessary corrections and feedback.

My hobbies include playing viola, watching movies and TV shows , reading, and traveling.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I am so excited to be a part of your English learning experience! I love seeing my students improve and achieve their goals. I know learning a new language can be a bit difficult but I want to make it a positive and fun experience.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I teach adult classes only. My "Let's Talk" conversation classes focus on speaking about a variety of topics such as small talk or more complex subjects. My grammar classes focus on developing my student's grammar skills in addition to vocabulary building, pronunciation and accent reduction  and overall comprehension. My lessons can be relaxed and focused on conversation and pronunciation or I can create a more structured class environment depending on what my students need.

I've always loved learning languages and I'm excited to share that hobby with you! My other interests include music, composition, travel, and sports such as swimming, kayaking, and rock climbing.

I've always loved learning languages and I'm excited to share that hobby with you! My other interests include music, composition, travel, and sports such as swimming, kayaking, and rock climbing.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I have 4 years of professional experience as an ESL teacher for students with a broad range of English ability. I've taught kids between the ages of 3 and 18 years old, but my preferred method of learning has always been conversation, so in my teaching, I like to focus on the way native speakers really talk. It's important to understand and be able to correctly utilize proper grammatical structures, so I make sure that the student has a grasp on proper speaking technique before moving on to more casual speaking patterns. I hope to help you improve your English through interesting conversation!
teacher_info.teaching_style: As these classes are conversation-based, I like to focus on practical use of English and pronunciation. Although I don't believe there is any harm in having an accent, I will encourage pronunciation of native English vowel sounds in certain words and phrases so as to minimize miscommunication during conversation. I also like to base the conversation around topics that interest you, the student, as these will be most helpful to you when you speak English in the real world. Whether it be prepping for a job interview or discussing your favorite TV show with your friends, I want to be able to help you better express yourself in a new language.

course_info.trial_description: Welcome to English class! See if my teaching style is a good fit for you in this trial class. Here, I'll introduce myself to you as well as ask you questions about yourself. Then, we can talk about your goals and how you would personally like to improve your English. From there, we can get started on what lessons plans would interest you.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description: In this class, we will focus on the English language through the casual, spoken lens. I can teach by example which phrases are more commonly used in casual conversation, as well as how they are pronounced. You can choose what topics you would like to speak about, so we can learn the language while speaking about something that interests you.

teacher_info.teaching_style: My lesson and teaching style is student centered. I understand the uniqueness of every student and I tailor my lessons and teaching style to fit the individual learning capacity of each student. course_info.trial_description: Each trial lesson is composed of variety topics/lessons depending on the students needs. It is open for pupils/students of all ages. Please reach out to me and we will discuss what your needs are and I will design a 30 minute lesson for you.

pro_course_detail.title: The Fundamentals of Learning the English Language : Phonics Awareness (1 on 1 with tutor)
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is geared toward the beginners of learning the English Alphabet. It's also great for those who are starting to learn the English Alphabet. Phonics is a branch of linguistics where the sounds and physical properties of human speech sounds are studied. This is exactly what this lesson is all about. The Awareness of Alphabet Phonics has three aspects : the image/picture, the name and the sound. Each letter is presented in fun motivational props, named in Upper and Lower Cases and each letter sound is articulated. Phonics reading will help pupils/student to recognize and associate sounds of the letters of the alphabet in the word they read. This will help them to improve in their reading skills and efficiency.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English Practice (1 on 1 with tutor)
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson are for those who want to enhance their English Language Proficiency through the use of tools such as structured responsive conversation, picture walk, stories or a given topic as deemed chosen by the Tutor or Tutee for discussion etc. and practice the conversation through the given medium. The Tutor will lead the Tutee (Pupil/Student) in a fun and interesting conversation that will encourage the Tutee to speak and use English Language in the Conversation. Along the way the Tutor will help the student with correct word usage, grammar and pronunciation. The goal is to encourage the student to speak in confidence using English Language. This lesson is designed to be highly motivating and fun experience for the student.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate/Advanced Level Group Conversational English Practice ( 6 students maximum/group)
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a student centered lesson to cater a group of intermediate/advanced level students (maximum of 6 students per group). The participants are those who are working to boost their level of conversation from Intermediate to Advanced Level or Advanced Level who desire to keep up or  brush up their conversational skills in English Language.
The lesson  includes a wide variety of topics for discussion such Culture and Entertainment, Technology, Economy, Business, Health, Travel Lifestyle, Campus Life work Life, Work, etc. The tutor will lead the group into an intense and fun filled conversation in different ways such as debate, discussion, role play, agree or disagree, making paired or multiple choices, using phrasal verbs and idioms/expressions in the conversation, etc.
Before the lesson ends the tutor will give the evaluation, discuss the outcome of the conversation and provide inputs.The lesson will be specifically designed by the tutor to fit the need of the group.
